title: Tekashi 6ix9ine Says He Rides Around With $1 Million Cash In His Trunk [Listen]
htmlContent:
On Wednesday morning, Tekashi 6ix9ine was on Clubhouse in the Sleepless LA room while driving home from Savannah, Georgia. During the question and answer session, he was asked how many more years he was on probation? He said four.

Then he was asked how he was able to move around despite being on probation. He answered that he could travel for work, but he must give the judge his itinerary at each location.

He was later what does he think his legacy is right now. "Y'all can look at it anyway wan to look at it. Right now I am a live, I'm 25 and have four documentaries out on Hulu, Amazon whatever the f*** platforms they put it on. I got four documentaries out right now and I'm still alive at the age of 25. I'm saying I was a f**** delivery boy in 2017 and in 2016 I was washing dishes. You ain't going to tell me that I did not have the hardest grind. I came up from the bottom n***. I treat my Rolls Royce Rafe like a sauna n***. Right Now I got a million dollars in cash. I'm a legend n***. I let my nuts drag. A n*** can never tell me nothing."

He would add that he could not put his confidence into words because he loves himself so much.
